description: Find races for a runner: marathons, half marathons and ultras worldwide by name, city, region, country, distance, date window or Boston-qualifier status ("a spring marathon in Ohio", "halves near Denver in October"). Returns up to 10 races (20 with an API key) with the next race date, registration status and Marathon Scout guide URL. With no text query, results are in date order.

boston_qualifier.description: true for Boston qualifying courses only.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or English name, e.g. US or Japan.

query.description: Race name or place, e.g. "chicago" or "big sur".

region.description: State or region name as written locally, e.g. Ohio or Bavaria.

name: search_races
title: Search races
